title: Exchange / Cold Copy
description: Verified escrow offers a fresh target. No faction commitment is required.
condition: All required objectives must be secured. Optional archives pay extra. Quiet bonus uses peak trace.
aftermath: The exchange settles another job. The city keeps changing.

lore.title: Exchange / Cold Copy / Unsent message
lore.text: MOTH / unverified relay: Verified escrow offers a fresh target. No faction commitment is required. The sender asks you to keep the names attached to the evidence; anonymous totals have concealed people before.

lore.title: Exchange / Cold Copy / Custody note
lore.text: Archive custody, Exchange / Cold Copy: The exchange settles another job. The city keeps changing. A second copy carries a hand-written objection to the official disposition.

lore.title: Exchange / Cold Copy / Private annotation
lore.text: Personal note filed under vesper-freelance-0: The exchange settles another job. The city keeps changing. Someone has crossed out the word inevitable. No replacement was supplied.

revelation: The exchange settles another job. The city keeps changing.
